data.narrative:
CarbonCure Technologies is a Series F-stage climate & energy company that has raised $169M to date. The valuation universe comprises 9 same-sector peers—1 public (LNZA) and 8 private companies including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though a sufficiently robust peer-median approach is constrained by limited same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within this narrow filter.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable triangulation tool. Using total capital raised ($169M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.3x step-up multiplier typical of Series F progression, this method yields an implied valuation of $220M. This represents the median point in the analysis, reflecting the advancement expected between funding rounds in frontier technology sectors where comparable transactions are sparse.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $187M (low) to $253M (high), with a median of $220M. The range spans approximately ±15% around the median point, reflecting inherent uncertainty in single-method triangulation. Key vulnerabilities include reliance on a stage-progression proxy rather than market-tested peer multiples, limited availability of same-stage comparables within Climate & Energy, and the broad dispersion in revenue and profitability profiles across the peer set. Revenue traction, unit economics, and technology readiness remain critical variables for narrowing this range in future rounds.
